findings: Every top instance and terminal, including filler and body pins, is checked against the captured OpenDB before constructing the independent master-CDL reference.
CRLF normalization fixes native OpenROAD master-port parsing; standalone CDL slash separators are removed without changing terminals or model names.
Only explicit symbolic SHORT cards join nets; ordinary valued resistors and transistor dimensions remain intact. Unsupported symbolic values fail.
The reference scale is numeric 1e-6 and extracted device dimensions are micrometres. Native 1 nm and 0.1 percent tolerances are unchanged.
Physical metal, contacts, diffusion, wells and substrate establish connections. No global supply tying, implicit connections or equivalent-pin declarations are used.
Each top pin annotation must overlap exactly one physical metal island. Labels move only within that overlap on a mask-identical comparison copy; pin marker polygons cannot bridge conductors.
APB pready and VDD share a physical net and also share a net through the independent CDL tie cell. Complete paired port groups preserve all 30 declared boundary names.
Windows/Linux re-create identical adapted GDS and reference inputs, re-read all native reports and reproduce digest 354f032e24578d6574816bee54e03698ccd32ef334f1e5456d34310344d1d8ff.
limitations: This checks the original HD blocks, not all SKY130 devices, stacks, operating conditions or arbitrary chips.
All 601 rule-inventory rows still need reviewed applicability and execution coverage. Density, broader antenna applicability, application integration and exact delivery remain incomplete.
Final connectivity and electrical checks must run again after a valid fill solution is established; the current fill pilot is not accepted.

Pin-marker extents exceed routing polygons in the retained exports. Unique-island label attachment establishes connectivity; complete macro boundary/abstract coverage remains production/delivery work.

The original rule-source capture includes CSV/RST documents. Referenced layer TSV files were not in that capture and still need explicit capture/reconciliation.
